name: Negative — HTTP client with timeout
diff:
diff --git a/fetch.go b/fetch.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/fetch.go
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func fetch(url string) (*http.Response, error) {
+	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
+	return client.Get(url)
+}
